name: omp-code
description: Claude Code-style chat GUI in the sidebar, backed by the omp (oh-my-pi) CLI over RPC. Supports custom model providers and the Anthropic Cloud API.
author: OMP Code contributors

ompcode.ompPath.description: Path to the omp CLI binary (oh-my-pi). Defaults to `omp` resolved via PATH (~/.bun/bin is added automatically).

ompcode.customProviders.markdownDescription: Custom model providers, same shape as the `providers:` map in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`. Merged into models.yml before each agent start. Example: `{"akemi": {"baseUrl": "http://host:8000/v1", "api": "openai-completions", "apiKey": "sk-...", "models": [{"id": "akemi-1", "name": "Akemi", "contextWindow": 128000, "maxTokens": 32000}]}}`

ompcode.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model to select after the agent starts, as `provider/modelId` (fuzzy matched), e.g. `akemi/akemi-1` or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. Empty = keep the agent's default.

ompcode.verifyModels.markdownDescription: Before offering a model, send it one throwaway request (`ping`, thinking off, no tools) through a separate session-less agent and keep only the models that answer. Hides models whose credentials are stale or whose subscription does not cover them. Verdicts are cached for 12 hours; refresh them from the model picker's "Re-check subscriptions".

ompcode.hideStartupNotices.markdownDescription: Hide the agent's internal startup notices (`xd://: mounted …`, `inspect_image is now hidden …`). Warnings and errors are always shown; suppressed notices still go to the "OMP Code" output channel.

ompcode.resumeLastSession.markdownDescription: When a new chat opens, resume the most recent omp session (across all workspaces) instead of starting blank.

ompcode.thinkingLevel.description: Thinking (reasoning) level applied after the agent starts.

enumDescriptions: Auto-approve reads; ask before writing files or running commands.
Auto-approve reads and file writes; ask before running commands.
ompcode.approvalMode.markdownDescription:
Tool approval tier, passed to omp as `--approval-mode`. Also settable from the `access:` chip in the chat composer.

Note: approving a single `task` call hands its subagent the same tier, so an approved task can run shell commands without asking again.

enumDescriptions: Coral accent (#D97757), the original Claude Code palette.
ompcode.theme.description: Accent palette of the chat panel. Applied live, without restarting the agent.

ompcode.accentColor.markdownDescription: Override the palette accent with a custom CSS color, e.g. `#8B7BF7` or `hsl(250 85% 72%)`. Empty = use `ompcode.theme`.

ompcode.modelProfiles.markdownDescription:
Per-model behaviour profiles, layered on top of the built-in ones. Each entry is `{ family, match: { id?, provider?, host? }, contextFile?, badge?, runtime?, spawn? }`; `match.id` is a regular expression **as a string**. Your rows always win over the built-ins, whatever their specificity.

Only policy belongs here — omp already resolves the thinking dialect, the effort ladder, stream timeouts and tool-schema shape per provider, and overriding those makes things worse, not better.

Example — never let one model run shell commands unattended:

```json
[{ "family": "qwen", "match": { "id": "qwen" },
   "spawn": { "overlay": { "tools.approval": { "bash": "prompt" } } } }]
```
